fusions.name: Wearing Down
fusions.desc: A kick at an enemy up to 3 tiles away that deals 7 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach, rising 10% for every tenth of health the target still has (max +40%). Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Hauling Blow
fusions.desc: A stamping blow that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Walked Cool
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bottomless Wind
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs dry, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
